map.计时器依次运行：训练 30s → 休息 10s → 训练 30s → 休息 10: The timer runs in sequence: training 30s → rest 10s → training 30s → rest 10s → training 30s (3 sets in total), so 90s of actual training and 20s of rest. After check-in the "consecutive days" increments by 1, and the statistics…
map.训练项目计时：在「管理项目」中添加康复动作（图标+名称+组数×单次时长），计时器: Training item timing: add rehabilitation movements (icon + name + sets × duration per set) under "manage items", and the timer counts down through training and between-set rest in a loop, prompting the end once all sets are done.
map.组间休息与多组循环：每个动作含「X 组 × Y 秒」，组间自动进入休息时间；可设: Between-set rest and multi-set cycles: each movement contains "X sets × Y seconds" and the timer automatically enters the rest period between sets; the rest duration can be set, helping control training density and preserve movement quality.
map.打卡与连续天数统计：每次完成训练即打卡，工具统计「连续打卡天数 / 今日打卡 /: Check-in and streak statistics: each completed training session counts as a check-in, and the tool tracks "consecutive days checked in / checked in today / total days / total sessions" with visual encouragement to keep going. The data is stored in your own browser and never uploaded.
map.算例：肩颈放松 3 组 × 30 秒、组间休息 10 秒: Worked example: shoulder and neck relaxation, 3 sets × 30 seconds with 10 seconds rest between sets
map.全部数据保存在你本机浏览器，纯前端处理、不上传任何服务器；换设备或清缓存会丢失，: All data is stored in your own browser, processed purely in the front end and never uploaded to any server; changing device or clearing the cache loses it, so record anything important yourself
map.怎样新增 / 删除训练项目？: How do I add or remove training items?
map.进入「管理项目」页可增删动作并设定组数与时长；删除后不影响历史打卡记录。项目仅存: In the "manage items" page you can add or remove movements and set the number of sets and the duration; removing an item does not affect past check-in records. The project is stored only in your browser's localStorage.
